imports: Emitted package self-reference public ESM exports: @scatterlab/stats/stats, /pca, /cluster
scope: Finite matching-contract R comparisons; KS default differences and independently implemented Xi reference explicitly distinguished.

conventions.correlation: pairwise finite numeric coercion, minimum3; Pearson and Spearman midranks
conventions.ks: D from stats::ks.test; Stephens-adjusted p separately, R default p measured as compatibility boundary
conventions.kmeans: ten explicitly recorded kmeans++ center matrices from existing Mulberry32(42+start), compare stats::kmeans Lloyd300 and choose minimumSSE; no shared-seed claim
conventions.pca: centered, population-SD scaling when enabled; prcomp sample eigenvalues multiplied(n-1)/n for population eigenvalues; signed-axis alignment

referenceProvenance.xi: Independent R exact predictor-tie permutation average of the paper formula, not a canonical-package call
